# Download the Microsoft Build of OpenJDK | Microsoft Learn

This article provides links to download the Microsoft Build of OpenJDK.

For instructions on how to install, see the [Install](install) page. Supported installation methods include:

- Graphical installation using platform-specific installers.
- Package manager installation using platform-specific package managers.

The following tables provide links to the package files for LTS (Long Term Support) releases, and their `.sha256sum.txt` and `.sig` files.

## OpenJDK 8

If you still require Java 8, you can download any of the [Eclipse Temurin builds of OpenJDK 8](https://adoptium.net/temurin/releases/?version=8) from the Eclipse Adoptium project.

## Linux DEB and RPM packages

Linux Packages (RPM and DEB files) are available at https://packages.microsoft.com. See [Install the Microsoft Build of OpenJDK](install) for more information.

If you run Java workloads on Azure, you can also install [Azure Command Launcher for Java (jaz)](/en-us/java/jaz/overview) from the same Microsoft Linux repositories.

## Container images

For use of Microsoft Build of OpenJDK in container images, see [Container images for the Microsoft Build of OpenJDK](containers).

## Public key to verify signature files

To verify the `.sig` files, download and use [the public key](https://download.visualstudio.microsoft.com/download/pr/b90071e2-e0cf-4411-98be-dbeb09d67bf0/8622862bcd54206e158c5abca0582c9b/464279_464280_aoc_20210208.asc).

## URLs for major versions only

Developers can also obtain the latest packages of an LTS release by using URLs without the specific minor version. For example, the following URLs download the latest version of OpenJDK 25:

Linux

```bash
curl -OL https://aka.ms/download-jdk/microsoft-jdk-25-linux-x64.tar.gz
```

macOS

```zsh
curl -OL https://aka.ms/download-jdk/microsoft-jdk-25-macOS-x64.tar.gz
```

Windows

```powershell
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri https://aka.ms/download-jdk/microsoft-jdk-25-windows-x64.zip
```

For a complete list of available URLs and versions, [see this page](download-major-urls).

This page only lists the latest updates available. To download older releases, visit [this document](older-releases).
